response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack/systems engineer with 15+ years across web, embedded, and high-performance backend work, but his resume shows no direct experience with experimentation platforms, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or growth systems, which are the core focus of this Principal-level role. His career path also shows Senior/Staff titles rather than the kind of large-scale, cross-org technical leadership expected at IC6/Principal for a specialized growth-experimentation domain.
strengths: 15+ years of broad engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and backend systems
Demonstrated experience with high-throughput, low-latency systems (Dunnhumby/Sociomantic handling millions of requests/sec)
Strong craftsmanship background: TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, workshops, and open-source platform building (GISCollective)
concerns: No evidence of experimentation, A/B testing, feature flagging, or rollout-risk management experience
No telemetry/metrics platform or growth-systems work mentioned anywhere in employment history
Career progression shows Senior/Staff-level roles, not clear Principal-level cross-team technical leadership at the scale this role requires

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering breadth and seniority (years of experience)
